title: Multiple services and applications spamming journal with "Failed to register with host portal" ""Could not register app ID: App info not found for 'org.kde.APPNAME'")"
line: The activity manager and power management services no longer fill the journal with "Failed to register with host portal … App info not found" warnings.
explanation: Qt registers every app with xdg-desktop-portal's host registry under QGuiApplication::desktopFileName(), and the portal rejects IDs that have no installed Type=Application desktop file. kactivitymanagerd (org.kde.ActivityManager) and powerdevil (derived as org.kde.org_kde_powerdevil) had none, so each start logged "App info not found"; baloo's extractor did the same on every run until baloo 0ff198fc (Nov 3) switched it to the offscreen platform, which has no portal services. The change installs a hidden desktop file for kactivitymanagerd, and gives powerdevil the desktop file name org.kde.powerdevil with a matching hidden desktop file, like kded6 already does.

commits.message:
service: install a desktop file for the activity manager

Qt registers kactivitymanagerd with the host portal using the app ID

"App info not found". Install a hidden one, as kded6 already does.

BUG: 515338

Qt registers powerdevil with the host portal using its desktop file

start logged "App info not found". Name it and install a hidden one.

patches.diff:
From 9663f11aca98c3f994702611eb9b9c89dc4d825b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:11:18 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] service: install a desktop file for the activity manager

Qt registers kactivitymanagerd with the host portal using the app ID
org.kde.ActivityManager, which had no desktop file, so each start logged
"App info not found". Install a hidden one, as kded6 already does.

BUG: 515338
---
 src/service/CMakeLists.txt                  | 5 +++++
 src/service/org.kde.ActivityManager.desktop | 8 ++++++++
 2 files changed, 13 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 src/service/org.kde.ActivityManager.desktop

diff --git a/src/service/CMakeLists.txt b/src/service/CMakeLists.txt
index 11be8ad1..52476008 100644
--- a/src/service/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/src/service/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -83,3 +83,8 @@ install (TARGETS
 install (TARGETS
    kactivitymanagerd_plugin ${KDE_INSTALL_TARGETS_DEFAULT_ARGS}
    )
+
+install (FILES
+   org.kde.ActivityManager.desktop
+   DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_APPDIR}
+   )
diff --git a/src/service/org.kde.ActivityManager.desktop b/src/service/org.kde.ActivityManager.desktop
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..a3780ea2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/service/org.kde.ActivityManager.desktop
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: None
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0
+
+[Desktop Entry]
+Name=Activity Manager
+Type=Application
+Icon=activities
+NoDisplay=true
-- 
2.53.0

From 265e76ae40fc1f497a305ceeb03e6356cfebe623 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:11:19 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] daemon: install a desktop file matching the app ID

Qt registers powerdevil with the host portal using its desktop file
name, derived as org.kde.org_kde_powerdevil with no such file, so each
start logged "App info not found". Name it and install a hidden one.

BUG: 515338
---
 daemon/CMakeLists.txt             | 1 +
 daemon/org.kde.powerdevil.desktop | 8 ++++++++
 daemon/powerdevilapp.cpp          | 1 +
 3 files changed, 10 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 daemon/org.kde.powerdevil.desktop

diff --git a/daemon/CMakeLists.txt b/daemon/CMakeLists.txt
index 7fb0b81e7..b6547c54f 100644
--- a/daemon/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/daemon/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -192,6 +192,7 @@ install(TARGETS powerdevil DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_FULL_LIBEXECDIR})
 
 install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/powerdevil.desktop
         DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_AUTOSTARTDIR})
+install(FILES org.kde.powerdevil.desktop DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_APPDIR})
 install(TARGETS powerdevilcore ${KDE_INSTALL_TARGETS_DEFAULT_ARGS})
 
 ecm_install_configured_files(INPUT plasma-powerdevil.service.in @ONLY DESTINATION
diff --git a/daemon/org.kde.powerdevil.desktop b/daemon/org.kde.powerdevil.desktop
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..11faea40d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/daemon/org.kde.powerdevil.desktop
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: None
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0
+
+[Desktop Entry]
+Name=Power Management
+Type=Application
+Icon=preferences-system-power-management
+NoDisplay=true
diff --git a/daemon/powerdevilapp.cpp b/daemon/powerdevilapp.cpp
index 451255ace..4677447d7 100644
--- a/daemon/powerdevilapp.cpp
+++ b/daemon/powerdevilapp.cpp
@@ -107,6 +107,7 @@ int main(int argc, char **argv)
     aboutData.addAuthor(i18nc("@info:credit", "Kai Uwe Broulik"), i18nc("@info:credit", "Maintainer"), QStringLiteral("kde@privat.broulik.de"));
     aboutData.addAuthor(i18nc("@info:credit", "Dario Freddi"), i18nc("@info:credit", "Previous maintainer"), QStringLiteral("drf@kde.org"));
     aboutData.setProductName("Powerdevil");
+    aboutData.setDesktopFileName(u"org.kde.powerdevil"_s);
 
     KAboutData::setApplicationData(aboutData);
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pure master: kactivitymanagerd and powerdevil log "App info not found" at session start, and baloo's file extractor logs it each time it runs.

With the fix (and baloo master): no "App info not found" left at session start or while indexing; only the unrelated "Connection already associated" lines that kded6 and plasmashell also print remain.
